faq: Can an AI agent answer trial class enquiries for my gym on WhatsApp?

Yes. 41 Closer sits on your WhatsApp Business number and answers at any hour. It asks the customer's goal and quotes from your price list. Then it books the trial or consultation slot. Your coach sees the booking in the inbox the next morning, and you can take over any chat yourself.
How much does a WhatsApp AI agent cost for a fitness studio in Singapore?

Starter is S$690 a month. Pro is S$1,490 a month and connects to your own booking or membership system. The build is included and there is no setup fee. Connecting a system we have connected before is a one-time S$2,400. No GST is charged.
Will it quote my session rate and my packs?

Yes, from the price list you give us. It asks the goal before it quotes, because the trainer we built this for told us a bare price goes cold. If you price every programme after a consultation, it says so and books the consultation. It will not invent a figure.
Can it book the trial into my calendar?

On Starter it takes the day and time and confirms it back to the customer. A booking card then lands in your inbox for a coach to confirm. On Pro it reads the live slots in your own booking system and writes the booking back. Your admin does not retype anything.
What if a customer asks something it does not know, like my cancellation policy?

It hands over to a person and tells the customer a coach will reply. It does not guess. Before go-live we list the gaps, such as cancellation terms, group size limits, the age range for kids and payment methods, and you fill them in. Every answer it gives comes from what you told us.
I only get a handful of enquiries a week. Is it worth it?

Maybe not yet. One personal training business with about five enquiries a week told us its problem was volume and paused. The agent answers what comes in and it does not bring new leads. If most of your enquiries arrive after hours and you lose them, it pays for itself. If they arrive in office hours and your admin answers in minutes, spend the money on ads first.
How long does it take to go live?

48 hours from the day we get your price list and your class or session list. We build the agent first and you message it on our demo line. Then one free hour to walk through the platform and connect your WhatsApp and payments. You are charged from the day it goes live.
Does it answer in Singlish or Chinese?
It answers in English and the mixed English Singapore customers type. Ask us before counting on Chinese or Malay. It does not take voice calls.
